entries.title: declared-tests-present claims every test path in a sentence once ANY edit verb appears in it: 'Create X, built on the harness Y already uses' declares Y, and a pre-existing reference file becomes a hard block (3 false positives on 2026-09-02/03)
spec-validation F's COMPLETE plans on format ('Implementation Plan has no numbered steps' vs plan-completeness=A) — align the specify brief to the deterministic contract
landing PR body: add a human-readable change DIGEST (prose summary) above the receipt — A18 infers a compliant title but no digest
spec_stage_acceptance gating-F path wedges ~5% of runs even with an observable-targeted wait

retire the byte-identical twin rule on the codex agents leg: a harness may carry its own instructions (Nico, 2026-09-03), so overlay_codex_leg_test must stop pinning agents/skills to the claude leg byte-for-byte

RevalidateCapability escalates with the HEAD of the plan output, so pub's upgrade-advice noise fills the 2000-char cap and the actual failure line is cut off; the gate reads '… (truncated)' and the governor must re-run the plan blind
grid_assets: station_overlay skill-file delivery — the format + non-destructive materialization lib (skill-file install; pow-a74 is the CLI over it)

spec-validation locates '## Validation Plan' and '## Implementation Plan' by substring, so a prose mention of the heading text (e.g. '(see ## Validation Plan)') is taken as the section and hard-blocks with 'has no items'

github_grid_assets tests fail whenever the operator's GRID_GITHUB_APP_KEY_* variables are exported: github_app_client_assets_test (2 cases) is coupled to the ambient process environment, so every land/revalidate for a github_grid_assets bead fails on an armed machine
CI red on every PR: acceptance harnesses construct StationKernel, deleted by the_grid #284 (grid_engine rc.11 / grid_sdk rc.9) — migrate to StationDriver + runGrid and adopt the wave
